items.label: CMAS
items.title: Carbon manganese alloy springs
items.description: Advanced carbon manganese coils are stress-relieved and strengthened for a comfortable sleeping experience. Independent suspension coil units are heat-treated under controlled conditions for better resistance and durability.

items.label: CertiPUR-US
items.title: Certified foams
items.description: CertiPUR-US approved foams are low-emission for indoor air quality, and made without ozone depleters, PBDEs, mercury, lead and heavy metals, formaldehyde or prohibited phthalates. VFI was awarded CertiPUR-US certification in 2021.

items.label: CertiGuard
items.title: Germ-free technology
items.description: Dust-mite allergens are the most common in Indian households and can cause restless sleep. CertiGuard brings cleanliness and protection into the mattress, for healthier rest and better sleep hygiene.

items.label: AeroSleep
items.title: Breathable foams
items.description: An exclusive open-cell, sustainable system with temperature-regulating properties that gives the best ventilation and comfort in its league, introduced with Springfit mattresses.

items.label: MCTS
items.title: Mattress comprehensive testing systems
items.description: Mechanical force testing systems perform compression and tensile tests on foam, furniture and mattresses, including the ASTM D3574 indentation force deflection (IFD) test and ISO 2439, with complete performance testing to EN 1957 and EN 1725.

items.label: Smart technology
items.title: An AI-enabled future
items.description: Smart mattresses use sensors to understand how you sleep and help improve it: sleep tracking, adjustable firmness, temperature control, position control and app integration.

texts.home.overview.heading: Comfort at a global scale.
texts.home.overview.intro: What began with one binding machine, a table and two mattresses a day is now a group of six smart factories and more than 1,100 people across India, exporting to twelve markets through our branches in Dubai and the USA.
texts.home.scale.heading: Built big. Built to last.
texts.home.story.kicker: Not just an organisation. An ideology.
texts.home.story.heading: We are the true bedmakers.
texts.home.story.text: More than thirty years ago, Mr. Mukesh Gupta started Varahamurti Flexirub with one mattress binding machine, a table and two mattresses a day. Today the group makes mattresses and soft furnishings for some of the world’s best-known hospitality and retail companies, with a corporate office in Delhi NCR.
texts.home.capabilities.heading:
Engineered with precision.
Built for scale.

texts.home.portfolio.intro: Mattresses, pillows, quilts and toppers, sofa and furniture foam, luxury sofas and recliners, and foam, latex and spring supply, from eight brands and six factories.

texts.about.hero.heading: A legacy of comfort. A future of innovation.
texts.about.hero.intro: Varahamurti Flexirub Industries Pvt. Ltd. creates mattresses and soft furnishings for some of the world’s best-known hospitality and retail companies.
texts.about.history.heading: It started with two mattresses a day.
texts.about.history.quote1: “Around 30 years ago, we started with making two mattresses in a day in a very small space and that’s all we had back then: one mattress binding machine and a table.”
texts.about.history.quote2: “I started working in different directions, finding new opportunities, but my heart was stuck with crafting mattresses and making unique comforts which people started appreciating.”
texts.about.timeline.heading: From two a day to 50,000 a month.
texts.about.mission.heading: Responsible, sustainable production.
texts.about.mission.text: Varahamurti follows strict manufacturing and quality-management protocols and good business ethics that define a framework for responsible and sustainable production. Our quality commitment extends to social, ethical and environmental responsibilities, and we are proud members of key industry associations.

texts.privacy.collect.heading: Information we collect
texts.privacy.collect.text: When you send an enquiry we collect the details you enter: your name, company, work email, country, estimated volume, enquiry type and message. We do not use advertising cookies. Your colour theme and unsent form drafts are stored only in your own browser.

texts.privacy.use.text: We use enquiry details only to respond to you, route your request to the right team and keep a record of business correspondence. We do not sell personal information.
texts.privacy.sharing.heading: Sharing
texts.privacy.sharing.text: Information may be shared within VFI Group and with service providers that host this website or deliver email on our behalf, under confidentiality obligations. We may disclose information where the law requires it.
texts.privacy.retention.heading: Retention and security
